mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast conditions near the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 70 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 72. The moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

In city news, the sticker design contest for our November election is now in the next phase. Students from grades K through 12 have submitted their artwork, and the community can vote on the winning designs starting July 28 through August 7. Also, the city reminds residents to inspect their mailboxes before winter plow season to ensure they meet U-S-P-S guidelines and avoid potential damage.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27 or head to trivia nights starting July 28 at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Reviewing the police department's report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had become stuck on a rock, resulting in an arrest for a first offense O-W-I.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is open until 10:30 PM, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
